build_meta_extension: build a python module that registers the MetaExtension to parse YAML front-matter meta data from markdown documents
create_metapreprocessor: create a MetaPreprocessor instance that parses key-value meta data lines from a list of markdown source lines
test_meta_regex: test the META_RE regex pattern against markdown meta data lines to extract key and value groups
review_metaextension_reset: review the MetaExtension reset method that clears the Markdown.Meta dictionary to an empty state
summarize_makeextension: summarize the makeExtension factory function that returns a MetaExtension instance with optional keyword arguments
